intro: Build your theory of change one level at a time. Your work is saved on this device only.
lastStepNotice: This is the last level. You can go back to any step to keep editing.
assumptionsHint: What else must be true for this level to work? One per line.
indicatorsHint: How will you know this level has been achieved?
savedNotice: Saved on this device. Nothing you type leaves your browser.
saveFailed: Your browser is blocking storage, so your work won't be kept if you close this page.
clearConfirm: This deletes everything you've typed, on this device. It can't be undone.

problem.question: What problem do you want to change?
problem.hint: Say who is affected, where, how much, and why it happens. Don't mention your project yet.

activities.question: What will you do?
activities.hint: The main things your team will do. Keep to the essentials.

outputs.question: What will your project deliver directly?
outputs.hint: Things you produce or provide, and can count.

outcomesShort.question: What will change first?
outcomesShort.hint: Early changes in knowledge, attitudes, skills or behaviour among the people you work with.

outcomesMedium.question: What will change after that?
outcomesMedium.hint: Changes that build on the first ones, usually within the life of the project.

impact.question: What long-term change are you contributing to?
impact.hint: The lasting change you hope to see. Your project contributes to it but doesn't control it alone.

illustrativeNotice: Illustrative example. The organisation, place and figures are invented.
draftPairsLabel: From first draft to stronger version
